ai_explanation.summary: For pain relief and reducing fever.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet with a large glass of water when in pain. Maximum 3 times per day.
ai_explanation.warnings: Do not drink alcohol. Wait at least 4 hours between doses.

ai_explanation.summary: Lowers cholesterol levels in your blood to protect your heart.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet every evening with water, with or without food.
ai_explanation.warnings: Do not drink with grapefruit juice.

ai_explanation.summary: A low dose of aspirin that helps prevent blood clots and protects the heart.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet each morning with food.
ai_explanation.warnings: Tell your doctor before any surgery or dental work.

ai_explanation.summary: A broad-spectrum antibiotic that treats bacterial infections.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 capsule every 8 hours with water. Finish the whole course.
ai_explanation.warnings: Keep taking it even if you feel better. Take with food if it upsets your stomach.

ai_explanation.summary: Slows the heart rate and lowers blood pressure to ease strain on the heart.
ai_explanation.simple_instructions: Take 1 tablet in the evening with food.
ai_explanation.warnings: Do not stop suddenly. Stand up slowly to avoid dizziness.
